description:
modules/workforce — GET /traeger/staff-exports/payroll (#4712, ADR 0249)
at a Träger with two schools and three contracts: the Träger values of the
payroll file, the Träger's schools, the binding of the Träger transaction,
its release, the records with their links, the month's contracts and their
Einsatzorte in one statement each; then per school the binding of its
tenant transaction and the month of its employments over the prefetch of
the school's payroll file (staff, profiles, persons, settings, sessions,
breaks, absences, adjustments, shifts, schedules, closing days, overrides,
snapshots). Flat in the number of people and contracts; one tenant
transaction per school (ADR 0105).
